blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Deonte Burton was thrilled to finally play his first official game for NLEX, which ended in a record win on Wednesday to start the resumption of the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup. And Burton made sure that the Road Warriors made the right choice in tapping him as replacement for the injured DeQuan Jones, with numbers that contributed in crushing the guest team Macau Giant Pandas, 138-78. “It feels really good just to be out here with the guys,” Burton said after finishing with 22 points, 14 rebounds, eight assists and six steals. “I was really excited to play, and I […]...
